name: Ancient City of Tauric Chersonese and its Chora
description: On the Black Sea coast near Sevastopol in Crimea, Chersonese was a Greek colony founded roughly 2,500 years ago. Visitors can walk among its ruined streets, theatre-era public buildings, early Christian churches and medieval towers. Beyond the city, the surrounding farmland was carved into hundreds of equal rectangular plots, and the vineyard walls still survive. Their wine was exported across the ancient world. The site is on the List in Danger.
